title: Interview With a Killer
description: In 2013, the small city of Weatherford, Texas was rocked by the brutal slaying of local son, JD Doss. The murder weapon? A pickaxe. The murderer? In one of David Scott's most shocking interviews, Camfield gives a glimpse inside his deranged, murderous mind.

title: Interview With a Killer

And this interview is unlike any that she's ever done. In this special episode of Interview With a Killer, host David Scott reveals the real Celeste - cunning, calculating, and deadly.
